major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Blades
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use at pull with Shadow Dance and Secret Technique ready; sync with on-use trinkets and potions for maximum burst overlap, and never use when Shadow Dance charges are depleted.

major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Dance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use only when Secret Technique is ready (except the second charge during Shadow Blades); never press during a global cooldown, and enter at 6+ combo points as Trickster or 0-2 combo points as Deathstalker.

major_cooldowns.name: Secret Technique
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast immediately as the first finisher inside Shadow Dance using a Dance + SecTech macro; its cooldown is haste-reduced so it naturally realigns with Shadow Dance over the course of a fight.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown at 0-2 combo points to follow with a Premeditation-boosted Shadowstrike; defer to utility use (interrupting a cast, mechanic immunity) when a specific encounter benefit exists.

rules.description: Secret Technique always inside Shadow Dance
rules.action: Always cast Secret Technique immediately after activating Shadow Dance; using Secret Technique outside of a Shadow Dance window is a critical DPS loss.

rules.description: Hold Dance and SecTech charges for Shadow Blades
rules.action: Stop spending Shadow Dance charges and Secret Technique when Shadow Blades is within 20 seconds of coming off cooldown; enter the Shadow Blades window with both cooldowns loaded and ready.

Open from Stealth with Shadowstrike, then immediately press Shadow Blades, Shadow Dance, and Secret Technique in sequence; use a combined Dance + SecTech macro to eliminate input delay and guarantee every global inside the first window.

rules.description: Enter Shadow Dance at correct combo point count
rules.action: As Trickster, enter Shadow Dance at 6 or 7 combo points to open with Secret Technique as your first finisher; as Deathstalker, enter at 0-2 combo points to get full Premeditation value on your first Shadowstrike inside Dance.

rules.description: Never press Shadow Dance during a GCD
rules.action: Wait until your current global cooldown completes before pressing Shadow Dance; any mid-GCD activation shrinks the usable Dance window and can cost you a full cast due to how Deepening Shadows calculates duration.

rules.description: Shuriken Storm and Black Powder at 2+ targets
rules.action: Replace Backstab with Shuriken Storm and Eviscerate with Black Powder at 2 or more targets; Shadowstrike remains preferred on 3 or fewer targets when Deathstalker's Mark must be maintained on the priority target.

rules.description: Always attack from behind for Backstab
rules.action: Stay behind the boss at all times to deal full Backstab damage and avoid parries; ask your tank to face the boss away from the raid if you cannot safely reach the rear.

rules.description: Use Vanish on cooldown at low combo points
rules.action: Press Vanish on cooldown whenever you have 2 or fewer combo points to chain into a Premeditation-empowered Shadowstrike that fills your combo bar in a single cast; only defer if a mechanic or interrupt offers greater value.
